application_summary.description: A comprehensive film management application providing features for managing films, actors, directors, users, and their relationships. Built with ASP.NET Core 8.0 and Entity Framework Core.
application_summary.tech_stack: .NET 8.0, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, SQL Server

executive_summary.description: The DB-Compatibility analysis of Films Web Application has identified 10 code updates that need to be performed in order to upgrade the application to be compatible with PostgreSQL 16

identified_updates.code_update: Replace Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer with Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL 8.0.0, EFCore.NamingConventions 8.0.0, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Relational 8.0.0
Replace UseSqlServer with UseNpgsql and add snake_case naming convention
Convert SQL Server connection string to PostgreSQL format with proper host, port, username, and password parameters
Convert all table names from PascalCase to snake_case (e.g., Films → films, UserRights → user_rights)
Convert all column names from PascalCase to snake_case (e.g., FirstName → first_name, CreatedDate → created_date)
Update DateTime properties to use 'timestamp without time zone' column type for PostgreSQL compatibility
Set default schema to 'public' for PostgreSQL in OnModelCreating method
Configure migrations history table with snake_case naming: __ef_migrations_history in public schema
Add PostgreSQL-specific retry policy with 5 max retries and 30-second delay
Enable sensitive data logging and detailed errors for development environment

application_summary.description: A comprehensive film management application providing features for managing films, actors, directors, users, and their relationships. Built with ASP.NET Core 8.0 and Entity Framework Core.
application_summary.tech_stack: .NET 8.0, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, PostgreSQL 16

executive_summary.description: The application has undergone significant changes in the transformation for DB-Compatibility to make it PostgreSQL ready. The transformation performed 10 successful updates across 7 files.

fixed_updates.updated_code: Host=localhost;Port=5432;Database=films;Username=postgres;Password=postgres;Pooling=true;Minimum Pool Size=0;Maximum Pool Size=100;Connection Lifetime=0;Connection Idle Lifetime=300;Timeout=30;Command Timeout=30

npgsqlOptions.EnableRetryOnFailure(
    maxRetryCount: 5,
    maxRetryDelay: TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30),
    errorCodesToAdd: null);

migration_rules_compliance.rule_description: All PostgreSQL database object names must use snake_case naming convention
migration_rules_compliance.implementation_details: Applied EFCore.NamingConventions package with UseSnakeCaseNamingConvention() in DbContext configuration. All table names and column names explicitly configured with snake_case using HasColumnName() and ToTable() methods.
migration_rules_compliance.verification_method: Examined DbContext configuration and confirmed all table and column names use snake_case. Migration SQL will generate proper snake_case names.
migration_rules_compliance.improvement_recommendations: Consider adding custom naming convention for special cases if needed in future

migration_rules_compliance.rule_description: Replace SQL Server packages with PostgreSQL packages
migration_rules_compliance.implementation_details: Removed Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer and added Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL 8.0.0, EFCore.NamingConventions 8.0.0, and Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Relational 8.0.0
migration_rules_compliance.verification_method: Reviewed Films.Infrastructure.csproj and confirmed correct package references
migration_rules_compliance.improvement_recommendations: Keep packages updated with latest stable versions

migration_rules_compliance.rule_description: Convert SQL Server connection strings to PostgreSQL format
migration_rules_compliance.implementation_details: Updated connection strings in appsettings.json and appsettings.Development.json with PostgreSQL format including Host, Port, Database, Username, Password, and connection pooling parameters
migration_rules_compliance.verification_method: Reviewed configuration files and confirmed proper PostgreSQL connection string format
migration_rules_compliance.improvement_recommendations: Use environment variables or Azure Key Vault for production credentials

migration_rules_compliance.rule_description: Replace UseSqlServer with UseNpgsql in DbContext configuration
migration_rules_compliance.implementation_details: Updated Program.cs to use UseNpgsql() with proper configuration including migrations history table, retry policy, and naming conventions
migration_rules_compliance.verification_method: Reviewed Program.cs and confirmed UseNpgsql configuration with all required options

migration_rules_compliance.rule_description: Configure DateTime properties to use timestamp without time zone
migration_rules_compliance.implementation_details: All DateTime properties in entity configurations explicitly set to use 'timestamp without time zone' column type using HasColumnType() method
migration_rules_compliance.verification_method: Reviewed all entity configurations in FilmsDbContext.cs and confirmed DateTime column type mappings
migration_rules_compliance.improvement_recommendations: Ensure application consistently uses UTC for all DateTime values

migration_rules_compliance.rule_description: Set default schema to public for PostgreSQL
migration_rules_compliance.verification_method: Reviewed FilmsDbContext.cs and confirmed default schema configuration

migration_rules_compliance.rule_description: Configure migrations history table with proper naming
migration_rules_compliance.implementation_details: Configured migrations history table as __ef_migrations_history in public schema using MigrationsHistoryTable() method
migration_rules_compliance.verification_method: Reviewed Program.cs and confirmed migrations history table configuration

migration_rules_compliance.rule_description: Add retry policy for database connection resilience
migration_rules_compliance.implementation_details: Configured EnableRetryOnFailure with 5 max retries and 30-second delay
migration_rules_compliance.verification_method: Reviewed Program.cs and confirmed retry policy configuration
migration_rules_compliance.improvement_recommendations: Monitor retry metrics in production and adjust parameters if needed

migration_rules_compliance.rule_description: Enable detailed logging for development environment
migration_rules_compliance.implementation_details: Added EnableSensitiveDataLogging and EnableDetailedErrors for development environment only
migration_rules_compliance.verification_method: Reviewed Program.cs and confirmed conditional logging configuration
migration_rules_compliance.improvement_recommendations: Ensure these are disabled in production for security

migration_rules_compliance.rule_description: Configure connection pooling for optimal performance
migration_rules_compliance.implementation_details: Connection string includes pooling parameters: Pooling=true, Minimum Pool Size=0, Maximum Pool Size=100, Connection Lifetime=0, Connection Idle Lifetime=300
migration_rules_compliance.verification_method: Reviewed connection strings and confirmed pooling configuration
migration_rules_compliance.improvement_recommendations: Monitor connection pool usage and adjust parameters based on load
